results.title: Delhi SIR: 78.5% of 33 lakh voter roll discrepancy cases resolved, says CEO
results.description: The Delhi Election Commission said it has ordered a special re-verification drive to re-enroll eligible voters who were left out of the draft electoral roll.

results.title: NGOs urge Scottish leaders to oppose Rosebank over Israeli settlement links
results.description: MAJOR human rights, climate and faith organisations have urged leaders to oppose Rosebank following news that the expansion could be affected by the UK's new sanctions on Israeli settlements
